_meta.what: Single source-of-truth manifest for the OWIsMind PRODUCTION agent system: project key, real DSS ids, dataset names, semantic model + tool bindings, fast-lookup config, guardrails. Mirrors CAPABILITIES in genai/agents/OWIsMind_orchestrator.py.
_meta.project_is: the DSS production project OWIsMind_PRD_V1_2 (key OWISMIND_PRD_V1_2). It was created by DUPLICATING the DEV project OWISMIND_DEV, so every id below is the DEV id preserved by the clone. Prod IS the clone: there is no separate PROD twin with different ids anymore. Versions advance by git branch (one branch per version, named after the prod project); the next dev branch is OWIsMind_PRD_V1_3-dev.
_meta.divergence_note: DEV and this clone may DIVERGE on the revenue Solution offer column: the Solution column was re-added on the CLONE side on 2026-07-08 (script genai/semantic-models/scripts/add_solution_and_repoint_prod_clone.py, validated in DSS). Treat this file as authoritative for the clone.
_meta.not_runtime: NOT imported at runtime. The Code Agent files stay standalone-pasteable; CAPABILITIES is inlined in the orchestrator. Keep this file in sync by hand.

metric.note: id has historical-snapshot duplicates (an update adds a new row, old rows kept). Volume = COUNT(DISTINCT id); a ticket's current state (status, duration, close date) = its latest snapshot (max lastUpdate). Duration_ticket_total is in minutes (AVG, never SUM by default). Set via the profile overrides too (agg COUNT_DISTINCT on id).
